control_flow: stopAtWall: if an obstacle is ahead, drive forward at 10 % without end; else call followLine.
followLine: if the line tracker sees black, curve left; else curve right.

likely_intent.description: Stop at a wall: when a wall is ahead, stay in front of it instead of driving into it.

branches.outcome: a wall is ahead: it drives forward at 10 % without end
no wall ahead: it follows the line

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left on black and curves right on the floor, without end
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a line (or beside it), bright light, nothing in front of it
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the floor, again and again
scenarios.title: Follows the line when no wall is ahead
assumptions: You only mentioned the wall; following the line comes from your program.

scenarios.coded_response: It drives forward at 10 % without end, into the wall
scenarios.initial_condition: A wall is ahead of the robot, either right in front of it or at the end of the line it follows
scenarios.trigger: The obstacle sensor sees the wall
scenarios.title: Stops at the wall
assumptions: Stopping at the wall means stopping before touching it.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It stops in front of the wall without touching it, and stays there

uncertainties: You said stop at the wall, but when the obstacle sensor sees a wall your program drives forward at 10 % without end, into it.
You didn't say anything about the line: following it comes from the program, and on a plain floor it curves right and circles.
The program reads no light sensor, so dim light is not a situation for it.
